name: Cimmerian-Mausoleum
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a binary sunset, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls biomass controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
